d:
The eighth studio recorded single, written, sung and composed by is here!
[Meri Baaton Mein Tu] is a song that I wrote when I was 16. It’s the first Hindi song that I ever made. It was inspired by a temporary break up with someone I was seeing back then - the emotions of which made me pour my heart-break out into this song. Today, 10 years later when I think of that entire situation, it seems like such a minor inconvenience but back then, it felt like my entire world was collapsing. And I guess, that’s exactly what new, young love feels like - explosive and crazy.
